# Changelog

## 0.2.0 — 2026-09-13

- English is the default; Chinese, Korean, Japanese, and Russian editions cover the catalog, sources, and public guides.
- Shared facts, localized descriptions and exports, language navigation, and completeness/staleness checks.
- Canonical data schema v2 declares English as the default locale.
- Protected main requires PRs, current Catalog checks, and resolved conversations; force pushes and deletions are disabled, including for administrators.

## 0.1.0 — 2026-09-13

- 100 public X accounts across 11 topics, with evidence and a separate research backlog.
- Original SVG artwork, generated README, JSON/CSV/handle exports.
- Git, contribution, AI-assisted maintenance rules, and offline CI.
